facts.en: Completed a transport documentation diploma at Fictional Seabriar Institute in 2019.
facts.zh: 2019 年在虚构海荆学院完成运输单证文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid shipping documents clerk at Fictional Northspool Freight from 2020-06 to 2026-06.
facts.zh: 2020-06 至 2026-06 在虚构北线货运公司任有薪航运单证文员。

facts.en: Compared booking references, package counts and dispatch dates across supplied shipping documents.
facts.zh: 核对所提供航运文件之间的预订编号、包装件数及发运日期。

facts.en: Requested corrected documents when carrier and warehouse references did not match.
facts.zh: 当承运人与仓库编号不匹配时，请求更正文件。

facts.en: Prepared document packets for a licensed external broker; the broker submitted formal declarations.
facts.zh: 为持牌外部代理准备单证包；正式申报由该代理提交。

facts.en: The candidate did not classify goods or determine duties independently.
facts.zh: 候选人不独立进行货物分类或确定税费。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet cross-checks, PDF annotations and document revision logs.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格交叉核对、PDF 标注及文件修订日志。

facts.en: Helped reconcile an archived set of 15 fictional consignments in 2025-08.
facts.zh: 2025-08 协助核对一组归档的 15 票虚构托运货物。

facts.en: Personally compared package weights shown in packing lists with carrier-summary fields.
facts.zh: 个人比较装箱单上的包装重量与承运人汇总字段。

facts.en: For that set, the packing lists recorded 18.4 tonnes of net goods mass and 21.1 tonnes of gross packed mass.
facts.zh: 该组货物的装箱单记录货物净质量为 18.4 吨、包装后毛质量为 21.1 吨。

facts.en: Those masses describe the same consignments on different bases; the gross figure includes packaging.
facts.zh: 这些质量数值以不同口径描述同一组货物；毛质量包含包装。

facts.en: The reconciliation found 3 weight-basis mismatches among the 15 carrier summaries; the broker confirmed the corrections before submission.
facts.zh: 该核对在 15 份承运人汇总中发现 3 处重量口径不匹配；代理在提交前确认更正。

facts.en: Tracked returned document versions and marked superseded copies in the archive.
facts.zh: 跟踪退回的文件版本，并在归档中标明已被替代的副本。

facts.en: Sent daily missing-document lists to warehouse contacts and the external broker.
facts.zh: 每天向仓库联系人及外部代理发送缺失文件清单。

facts.en: Attended an internal introduction to dangerous-goods document routing in 2024; no handling or classification qualification was awarded.
facts.zh: 2024 年参加内部危险品单证转交流程入门培训；未授予操作或分类资格。

facts.en: Drafted a bilingual packing-list glossary in 2026-01; only the internal supervisor reviewed it.
facts.zh: 2026-01 起草双语装箱单词汇表；仅经内部主管审阅。

facts.en: No external certification of that glossary’s translation is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录该词汇表翻译的外部认证。

facts.en: Made a personal scale-model cargo manifest in 2023 using imaginary vessels and goods.
facts.zh: 2023 年使用想象中的船舶及货物制作个人比例模型货物清单。

facts.en: Volunteered to inventory borrowed tables for Fictional Harbor Lantern Club in 2022-07.
facts.zh: 2022-07 志愿为虚构港灯社清点借入桌子。

facts.en: Enjoys building model lighthouses from scrap cardboard.
facts.zh: 爱好使用废纸板制作灯塔模型。

facts.en: No independent customs brokerage or dangerous-goods sign-off authority is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录独立报关代理或危险品签署批准权限。
